# InterContinental Hotels Group PLC

> > Official corporate site for IHG Hotels & Resorts, one of the world's leading hotel companies with brands including InterContinental, Six Senses, Hotel Indigo, Holiday Inn, and Holiday Inn Express.

IHG operates a diverse portfolio of hotel brands across luxury, lifestyle, and essentials segments in markets including UK & Ireland, Latin America & Caribbean (MLAC), and globally. The company focuses on responsible business practices, sustainability, and community impact while delivering shareholder value through strategic hotel development and brand management.

## Hotel Brands

- [Holiday Inn Express](https://www.ihgplc.com/en/our-brands/holiday-inn-express): Holiday Inn Express brand overview - IHG's biggest hotel brand worldwide
- [Holiday Inn Hotels & Resorts](https://www.ihgplc.com/en/our-brands/holiday-inn): Holiday Inn Hotels & Resorts brand overview and service philosophy
- [Six Senses Hotels Resorts Spas](https://www.ihgplc.com/en/our-brands/six-senses): Six Senses luxury brand focused on wellness and sustainability
- [Hotel Indigo](https://www.ihgplc.com/en/our-brands/hotel-indigo): Hotel Indigo lifestyle brand inspired by local neighborhoods worldwide
- [Vignette™ Collection](https://www.ihgplc.com/en/our-brands/vignette): Vignette Collection: independent luxury hotels with authentic experiences
- [Ruby](https://www.ihgplc.com/en/our-brands/ruby): Ruby boutique hotels in European city centers including London & Geneva
- [Avid hotels](https://www.ihgplc.com/en/our-brands/avid): Avid hotels: budget-friendly brand delivering essentials exceptionally well
